scope: Proposition 8.2 of the manuscript “Squarefree values of quartics and power-free values of polynomials” (preprints/Squarefree-values-of-quartics-and-power-free-values-of-polynomials-September-24-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 020 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c032023361538707), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are finitely many polynomials Φ ∈ L[t] of degree five with distinct critical points z1 = 0, z2 = 1, z3, z4 satisfying Φ(zi) = θi (1 ≤ i ≤ 4). Let Ff be this finite family and put Ef = {n ∈ Z : n = Φ(z) for some Φ ∈ Ff , z ∈ L}. Then, for X ≥ 1, # Ef ∩ [−2X, 2X]  ≪f X1/5 . (8.5) Moreover, if N(s) ∈ L[s] has degree five and distinct critical points τ1, . . . , τ4 ∈ L with N(τi) = θi, every integer value N(s) at s ∈ L belongs to Ef .
